ideas.name: Forward-Discount Currency Carry
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by forward discount each month, then go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
ideas.quote: We identify this common risk factor in the data by building monthly portfolios of currencies sorted by their forward discounts.

rules.market: Currency forwards; the paper includes major and other currencies.
rules.entry: Go long the highest-interest-rate currency portfolio and short the lowest-interest-rate currency portfolio.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency baskets.
